ctx.x: And so then when I came back -- while we were still in the United States we did a picture for a Swedish film company called The Boy In the Tree and that was the last thing I did with the band. So I'm sitting in my room,
I had just been to the union to collect my check for that picture, and Snodgrass, he was the manager for Basie, come up to me and --
